# Forkcast: Ethereum Upgrade Tracker

> Source: https://github.com/ethereum/forkcast

Forkcast tracks Ethereum network upgrades, EIPs, protocol calls, devnets,
upgrade planning, and protocol decisions.

## Site shape

Forkcast is a static Astro site. Route HTML is useful without running client
JavaScript, so agents can fetch pages directly and extract content from the
rendered document.

Primary route families:

- `/` - upgrade overview, recent proposals, calls, and decisions
- `/upgrades` - network upgrade index
- `/upgrade/{id}` - network upgrade detail pages
- `/upgrade/glamsterdam/{tab}` - Glamsterdam planning views
- `/eips` - proposal index with rendered cards and table rows
- `/eips/{number}` - EIP detail pages with analysis and rendered spec content
- `/calls` - protocol call calendar
- `/calls/{series}/{number}` - protocol call detail pages
- `/devnets` - devnet index
- `/devnets/{id}` - devnet detail pages
- `/decisions` - protocol decisions grouped by call
- `/agenda` - agenda planning artifacts
- `/schedule` - static schedule planning view
- `/rank` - Glamsterdam candidate ranking view

Legacy URLs such as `/planner`, `/glamsterdam`, `/priority`, and
`/complexity` are present as redirect pages.

## Static artifacts

Call artifacts are served as static files organized by series and call number:

- Pattern: `/artifacts/{series}/{date}_{number}/{file}`
- Example: `/artifacts/acde/2026-04-09_234/tldr.json`

Available files vary by call and may include:

- `tldr.json` - structured highlights grouped by topic, with timestamps
- `key_decisions.json` - decisions made during the call, with EIP references
- `transcript.vtt` / `transcript_corrected.vtt` - full call transcript
- `chat.txt` - call chat log
- `config.json` - call metadata

Recent ACDE and ACDC calls generally include `tldr.json` and
`key_decisions.json`. Older calls may only include transcripts and chat logs.

## Reading guidance

For proposal context, prefer `/eips/{number}` because it combines Forkcast's
analysis fields with the rendered EIP markdown. For raw meeting artifacts,
fetch `/artifacts/...` files directly. For overview tasks, start with `/`,
`/upgrades`, `/eips`, `/calls`, `/devnets`, and `/decisions`.
